name: Deserts
overview: The Scriptures depict deserts as places of desolation and barrenness, often illustrating the consequences of divine judgment and human unfaithfulness. Jeremiah 12:10-13 describes how the Lord's vineyard is made a desolate wilderness, mourning because no one cares, with the land overrun by spoilers and the sword of the Lord devouring from end to end. Efforts to cultivate the land result only in thorns and shame, emphasizing the severity of God's fierce anger and the futility experienced in these dry, desolate regions.
